SELECT s.id AS id, s.product_id AS productId, p.store_name AS productName, p.image AS productImage, s.attr_value_id AS attrValueId, IFNULL(v.suk, '') AS skuName, s.stock AS stock, s.warning_stock AS warningStock, CASE WHEN s.warning_stock > 0 AND s.stock <= s.warning_stock THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isWarning, s.update_time AS updateTime FROM eb_stock s LEFT JOIN eb_store_product p ON p.id = s.product_id LEFT JOIN eb_store_product_attr_value v ON v.id = s.attr_value_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND (p.is_del = 0 OR p.is_del IS NULL)
AND p.store_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywords}, '%')
AND s.warning_stock > 0 AND s.stock <= s.warning_stock
ORDER BY s.update_time DESC, s.id DESC
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(stock), 0) FROM eb_stock WHERE product_id = #{productId}
